name: Analytics
author: Squilla
description: First-party, cookieless web analytics measured on the server. Zero JavaScript on the public site; optional CSS beacon for viewport and colour scheme. Bots and AI crawlers are counted separately.

mcp_tools.name: summary
mcp_tools.description: Totals for a period: visitors, pageviews, visits, pages per visit, single-page rate, median visit length, conversions and conversion rate, plus sparklines. With in-page signals on, 'confirmed' holds the same totals for signal-confirmed visits only — compare it with 'current' to see how much of the traffic is real people. Start here.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the site time zone. Default: 29 days before 'to'.

f.verified.description: Set to "1" to count only visits confirmed by an in-page signal (needs enhanced_mode). Scrapers that pose as browsers never send one, so use this for real-people numbers.

mcp_tools.name: settings.get
mcp_tools.description: Current analytics settings (time zone, exclusions, retention, in-page signals).

mcp_tools.name: settings.update
mcp_tools.description: Change analytics settings. Send only the fields to change.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; changing it rebuilds rollups.

respect_gpc.description: Count Global Privacy Control visitors in aggregate only.

own_hosts.description: Extra host names treated as internal referrers.

mcp_tools.name: goals.list
mcp_tools.description: All goals.

mcp_tools.name: goals.create
mcp_tools.description: Create a goal.

kind.description: pageview = a page is viewed; request = any request matches (e.g. a form POST); link = a tracked /go/<slug> link is clicked.

path_pattern.description: Path glob for pageview/request goals, * matches anything, e.g. /forms/submit/*.

method.description: HTTP method for request goals, e.g. POST. Empty = any.

link_slug.description: Tracked link slug for link goals.

mcp_tools.name: goals.delete

mcp_tools.name: links.list
mcp_tools.description: Tracked links (/go/<slug>) with their clicks in the last 30 days.

mcp_tools.name: links.create
mcp_tools.description: Create a tracked link: /go/<slug> redirects to the destination and counts the click.

destination.description: Absolute URL the visitor is redirected to.
